sentences.text:
Author: Joymalya Bagchi
Bench: Joymalya Bagchi

1 
06.03.17
Sl. No.200 akd C. R. R. 685 of 2017 In Re : Madhusudan Dolai ... Petitioner Mr. Sourav Chatterjee ...
... for the petitioner Mr. Ayan Basu ... ... for the State
It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the viscera report does not disclose presence of poison in the viscera of the victim.
Hence, the petitioner is liable to be discharged from the instant case.
Mr. Ayan Basu, learned Government advocate, who ordinarily appears for the State, is requested to appear in the instant case for the State.
A copy of the revision petition be handed over to Mr. Basu in course of the day.
Let this matter appear under the heading 'Motion Adjourned' two weeks hence.
Let a copy of this petition be served upon the opposite party no. 2 by Registered Post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit-of-service on the next date of hearing.
Mr. Basu is directed to produce the case diary on the next date of hearing.

There shall be stay of further proceeding in S.C. No. 21(4)/16 pending before the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Fast Track, Haldia, Purba Medinipur arising out of Nandigram Police Station Case No. 445 of 2015 dated 22nd October, 2015 under Sections 272/273/304/120B/3/328 of the Indian Penal Code, Section 46AA of the Bengal Excise Act and Section 16(3) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act for a period of four weeks from date or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
Liberty is given to the parties to apply for extension and/or modification and/or variation of this order upon notice to the other side.
Photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be given to the petitioner on usual undertaking.
(Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
CRR-685-2017 on 6 March, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68371681/
